scope: Already-inspected WTB development only. Finite predeclared reserve-layer information lattice conditional on the common wind/power-based forecast; no end-to-end signal minimality, Bayes optimality, independent confirmation or E04/E07 modification.

task.point_forecaster: Preset squared-error histogram boosting from wind/power history only, published six steps before reserve issue; predicts twelve steps after publication
task.population: All finite future net-export targets on registered coordinates, independent of pitch availability
task.scope: Turbine-level risk-screening surrogate conditional on a synthetic legally earlier common forecast; no PCC procurement or storage-deliverability claim

primary_lattice: pitch_withheld: Common plus all 7 nonempty subsets of W,P,Q crossed with 1/6/36 last-arrived observations. No subset removed after results.
sample_rule: One shared seed-specific permutation of every finite training-target row over the unchanged Day136-175 calendar stage; budgets are nested prefixes, identical across subsets/estimators/conditions. No training-stage or test outcome filtering. Rows are correlated, not independent weather episodes.
feature_rule: common4 + W36 + P36 + Q36 + pitch36 oldest-first. L observations end at issue-delay, truncated at issue-35. Available pitch history is shared across every candidate in pitch-observed conditions. No forward-fill. Missing inputs preserved, target finite-mask independent of input subset.

HGB.missing_preprocessing: SimpleImputer constant zero with add_indicator=True and keep_empty_features=True, fit only on the corresponding historical fit stage. Added after v1 remote preflight caught sklearn1.9 all-NaN column failure; no v1 model results produced.
HGB.subsampling: One archived shared set of policy-fit sample indices per seed; no evaluation-based selection
HGB.fit_budget_authority: Explicit per-worker archived nested indices from budgets/pressure_budgets; no hidden 120k cap.

estimators.MLP: Direct exact Q.90 pinball, linear output then inference clip0. Historical per-feature finite mean/std imputation and fixed full missing indicators; target scale training std. CPU deterministic.

optimizer_scope: Epoch count fixed; increasing sample size also increases optimizer updates/compute. Curves measure joint data+training-budget scaling. Training trace saved. No claim of pure sample efficiency or proof of approximation-error saturation.
persistence: max(common_forecast-last-arrived active power,0); missing last power gives raw0 followed by identical historical offset family. No model fitting; 5 copies are the same deterministic function, not independent replicates.
maturity: offset-fit issue+6+1 < selection start; original prepared stage boundary already matures selection labels before eval. No model reads development evaluation before global historical choices are frozen.
historical_rule: For each condition,subset,estimator,budget choose one offset q shared by five seeds. Among levels passing ALL-seed simultaneous historical risk upper<=.10, choose minimum seed-mean selection cost, tie lower q. If none pass choose .99 diagnostic and mark unqualified. No further q grid/cap expansion. Global historical risk family spans every registered candidate/seed/condition/budget.
inference: Paired common natural-day circular moving-block bootstrap. All candidates/conditions/seeds share time draws. Mean cost conditional on frozen five instances; risk for each instance. Chunked max standardized joint envelope includes all within-condition-and-budget all-pair mean-cost ratios and per-seed risk. Self ratios algebraically zero; other constant bootstrap coordinates unbounded. Approximate dependent-data inference, no finite-sample guarantee. Entire epsilon curve covered; tolerances are sensitivity values, not externally justified engineering thresholds.
resource_order: incremental telemetry channel count including available pitch
estimator_order: HGB and MLP with same signals/width tied by declared order. Actual model bytes, fit/inference time and parameters reported descriptively; no claim they have identical compute complexity or post-result tie breaking.
primary_output: historically chosen candidate family evaluated once, all choices/failures retained
secondary_output: Explicit retrospective full fixed offset-grid capability frontier. Never overwrites primary historical-selector failure.
stop_rules: No evaluation-based hyperparameter/subset/epoch/budget/q/cap changes. Preserve all seeds, nulls and failures.
